page.overview:
Who is Inaho?

Inaho, like her teammates, is overconfident in her and her team's abilities to the point where she thought Team Ajisai fled because they were too powerful which wasn't the case.

Inaho's short brown hair frames her face, falling over her blue-clothed forehead protector which is worn normally. She wears a green top, brown knee-length skirt along with a beige sash and a poncho top. At the second Chūnin exams two years later, her hair has grown longer and was tied back a few inches above the end in a loose ponytail.

In the anime, Inaho fought using explosive tags in tandem with kunai. Like the members of her team, Inaho is quite tough and fast, being one of the thirty people who managed to reach Sunagakure from Konohagakure in three days.

She and the rest of her team entered the Chūnin Exams, but when Komugi chose not to complete the first phase fearing that they would never get the opportunity to retake the test if they failed as Ibiki Morino said, the rest of her team was disqualified as well.
